pre_condition: proj_dir is a path to an existing directory. config provides access to the runtime configuration needed by environment checks.
post_condition: The directory fm_agent/ is created under proj_dir if it did not already exist (no-op if it exists). When the LLM backend is configured as codex-cli or claude-cli, only the codegraph-version check is performed; when the backend is any other value, all four environment checks (LLM API key, oh-my-openagent, comment-checker, and codegraph version) are performed. Any check whose check_id appears in the previously persisted ignored-checks file within fm_agent/.env_check_memory is skipped. If every performed check reports success, the function returns True without logging warnings. If any performed check fails: the failing checks are collected. When stdin is not a TTY, the warnings are logged and True is returned. When stdin is a TTY, the warnings are displayed and the user is prompted with three actions — proceeding (returns True, warnings are re-shown on the next invocation), ignoring (persists the failing check_ids to the ignored-checks file and returns True, those checks are skipped on subsequent invocations), or quitting (returns False). The prompt repeats indefinitely for any input that is not one of the three action characters. The function does not modify config or any files outside fm_agent/ under proj_dir.
